title: Yes, Mary
paragraphs: Mary was a young woman in Nazareth, an ordinary village. One day the angel Gabriel visited her. Gabriel greeted her and said that God was with her. Mary was puzzled and afraid. Gabriel told her not to be afraid: she would have a son, she was to name him Jesus, he would be great, and his kingdom would never end. Mary asked a sensible question: how could this be? Gabriel explained that this was God's own doing, and added that her cousin Elizabeth was also expecting. Then Mary said, "Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word" (KJV). She said yes. In that quiet yes the whole world turned.
wonder: I wonder what it took for Mary to say yes?
activity: Pick one small "yes" you'll offer someone today: a helping hand or an open ear.
prayer: God, give us the courage of Mary to say yes to your call, even when it is hard. Amen.
alt: A young woman in a plain room listens to a tall winged angel whose wings are made of golden thread.
hidden: A white lily in a jug.
translation: Retold in our own words, with a short quotation from the King James Version.
